title: Mental Health and wellbeing in school
summary:
The city of Braunschweig aims to develop and implement a program/curriculum from grades 1-12 to strengthen the mental health of children and youth and implement it in schools. The implementation of the prevention program LARS&LISA in secondary schools is the first step. In previous studies, LARS&LISA has been implemented almost exclusively by psychologists. In this study, the program will be implemented by group leaders with different professional backgrounds (e.g., school social workers, teachers).  
Furthermore, the previous studies can be understood as mostly efficiency studies, meaning the aim was to determine whether the program produces the expected result under ideal circumstances (e.g. weekly supervision of the group leaders). This study is clearly an effectiveness study, meaning the aim is to measure the degree of beneficial effect under “real world” conditions. Accordingly, the group leaders are trained by an employee of the Arbeiterwohlfahrt and the city of Braunschweig and the Arbeiterwohlfahrt coordinate and implemente the program.
conditions: depressive symptoms, life satisfaction, externalizing problems

interventions.name:
LARS&LISA prevention condition:
The school-based universal cognitive-behavioral prevention program LARS&LISA will be delivered once per week over a 10-week period during regular school hours. Each LARS&LISA session is 90 minutes long.

School as usual control condition:
The youth in the control condition participate in the usual school lessons (no treatment control condition).
